items.title: Alex Bigard Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, and Morgan was there. Morgan was there. ... [INTERVIEWEE] And you played Royal Garden Blues and Sister Kate. That's right. I can remember that.

ctx.x: Yeah, and Morgan was there. Morgan was there. And Black Benny Turner. That's right, that's right. And I went down to see Big Eye at Lutchen's, I remember that. Yeah, that's right.

And you played Royal Garden Blues and Sister Kate. That's right. I can remember that. But then he was a sick man during the time you'd say anything, he was a sick man. But he made it on those last courses.
